description: This source file is a Perl script that processes target metadata and generates configuration and profile makefiles for a build system, particularly related to OpenWRT targets. It includes functions for parsing and pretty-printing target configurations, handling features, dependencies, and profiles, and generating structured output for build configurations.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Analyzes a list of feature strings and returns a string with corresponding configuration lines for building or dependencies.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Constructs a display name for a target, including parent target if applicable.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts a version string into a uniform format for comparison and usage in configuration variable naming.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Outputs build configuration snippets for a specific target, including features, dependencies, and help text.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two package lists into a sorted unique list, respecting exclusions.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function that parses target metadata and generates a comprehensive configuration file for build targets.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile variables based on target profiles.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Handles command-line arguments and dispatches to the appropriate generation functions.
